safi-cedvel:1-3.t:
* I'rab:
(ويل) is a nominative mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: what made it permissible to begin with it is its indicating supplication.] ; (للمطفّفين) is attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (الذين) is a relative in the position of a genitive, a naʿt (adjective) of المطففين [Note: or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هم" (they), the nominal sentence being an explanatory resumption.] ; (على الناس) is attached to (اكتالوا) [Note: al-Zamakhsharī said: Since their measuring is a measuring in which they are treated unfairly, (على) was put in place of (من) to indicate that; it is also possible that it is attached to (يستوفون) .] ; (أو) is for conjunction..
Clause: «ويل للمطفّفين ... » has no grammatical position, inceptive.
And the clause: «the condition, its verb and its apodosis ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «اكتالوا ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of a genitive construct).
And the clause: «يستوفون» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «the second condition, its verb and its apodosis» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the first conditional clause.
And the clause: «كالوهم ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «وزنوهم ... » is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause كالوهم.
And the clause: «يخسرون» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

* Morphology:
(المطفّفون): plural of المطفّف, an active participle of the quadriliteral طفّف, on the pattern مفعّل (with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn).
(2) اكتالوا: it has an ʿilāl (weak-letter change) by substitution: the ʿayn of the verb was turned into alif, having been vowelled after a fatḥa; its pattern is افتعلوا.
(يستوفون): it has an ʿilāl by making sākin and an ʿilāl by deletion; its origin is يستوفيون (with a yāʾ after the fāʾ): the vowel of the yāʾ was transferred to the fāʾ because of heaviness, then the yāʾ was deleted because of the meeting of two sākin letters; its pattern is يستفعون.
(3) كالوهم: it has an ʿilāl by substitution, by analogy as in اكتالوا..

* Rhetoric:
Antithesis (al-muqābala): in His saying, the Exalted, «الَّذِينَ إِذَا اكْتالُوا عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ وَإِذا كالُوهُمْ أَوْ وَزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ» .
That is, the meaning is: when they take from people they take in full, and when they give to them they give short.

* Benefits:
Do not diminish people's things: these verses indicate the severe threat and the painful punishment in the Hereafter for those who shorten measure and weight and cheat people of their rights, while if they are owed a right they take it in full. This threat covers little and much of the cheating of a right. This sin is one of the major sins; whoever does not repent of it is feared to suffer a bad ending. If he repents and returns the rights to their owners, his repentance is accepted; whoever persists in it is persisting in one of the major sins. This is because people at large need transactions, and these are built upon measure, weight and cubit-measurement; for this reason Allah, Mighty and Majestic, made much of the matter of measure and weight. Nāfiʿ said: Ibn ʿUmar used to pass by a seller and say to him: Fear Allah, give full measure and weight, for the cheaters will be made to stand on the Day of Resurrection until their sweat bridles them. Qatāda said: Give in full, son of Adam, as you love to be given in full, and be just as you love to be treated justly. Al-Fuḍayl said: Cheating in the scale is blackness on the Day of Resurrection.

safi-cedvel:4-6.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) is for an interrogative of denial and reproach; (لا) is a negative; (ليوم) is attached to (مبعوثون) ..
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّهم مبعوثون) is in the position of an accusative, standing in place of the two objects of يظنّ.
(يوم) is an accusative adverb of time, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being يبعثون; (لربّ) is attached to (يقوم) .
Clause: «يظنّ أولئك ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «يقوم الناس ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of a genitive construct).

safi-cedvel:7-9.t:
* I'rab:
(كلّا) is a particle of rebuke and deterrence from what they were doing of cheating in measure and heedlessness of the resurrection; (اللام) is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (في سجين) is attached to the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; (الواو) is resumptive; (ما) is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative, a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is the clause أدراك; (ما) is like the first, its khabar being (سجّين) ; (كتاب) is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو" (it).
Clause: «إنّ كتاب الفجّار لفي سجّين» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «ما أدراك ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: or parenthetical, between the first كتاب and the explanatory clause that explains it.]
And the clause: «أدراك ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما) .
And the clause: «ما سجّين ... » is in the position of an accusative, the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb أدراك.
And the clause: « (هو) كتاب ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.

* Morphology:
(سجّين): a proper noun either for a book in which the deeds of devils, unbelievers and the wicked are gathered.. or a proper noun for a particular place; its pattern is فعّيل (with kasra on the fāʾ and a doubled ʿayn), taken from السجن ("prison"); it is said that the nūn is a substitute for the lām and the origin is سجّيل, which is derived from السجلّ, meaning "book".
(مرقوم): a passive participle of the triliteral رقم, on the pattern مفعول.

safi-cedvel:10-13.t:
* I'rab:
(ويل ... للمكذّبين) is like ويل للمطفّفين [Note: in verse (1) of the sūra.] ; (يومئذ) is a badal (substitute) for (يوم يقوم) [Note: in verse (6) of this sūra.] ; (الذين) is a relative in the position of a genitive, a naʿt (adjective) of المكذّبين [Note: or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هم" (they), the nominal sentence being an explanatory resumption.] ; (بيوم) is attached to (يكذّبون) ; (الواو) is circumstantial, or resumptive; (ما) is a negative; (به) is attached to (يكذّب) ; (إلّا) is for restriction; (كلّ) is the nominative fāʿil (agent) of (يكذّب) ; (عليه) is attached to (تتلى) ...
Clause: «ويل ... للمكذّبين» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «يكذّبون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «ما يكذب به إلّا كلّ ... » is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) from يوم الدين [Note: or resumptive, with no grammatical position.] .
And the clause: «the condition, its verb and its apodosis ... » is in the position of a nominative, a naʿt of كلّ معتد.
And the clause: «تتلى عليه آياتنا ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of a genitive construct).
And the clause: «قال ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: « (هي) أساطير ... » is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech (maqūl al-qawl).

safi-cedvel:14-14.t:
* I'rab:
(بل) is for a transitional turning-away (iḍrāb intiqālī); (على قلوبهم) is attached to (ران) ; (ما) is a relative noun in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent), and the returning pronoun is omitted.
Clause: «ران على قلوبهم ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «كانوا يكسبون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما) .
And the clause: «يكسبون ... » is in the position of an accusative, the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

* Morphology:
(ران): it has an ʿilāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its origin is رين (its imperfect being يرين): the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa and was turned into alif.

safi-cedvel:15-17.t:
* I'rab:
(عن ربّهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (محجوبون), with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "from seeing their Lord", and likewise the adverb (يومئذ) ; the tanwīn is a substitute for a clause, i.e. "the day when the people stand"; (اللام) is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis, in the two places; (ثمّ) is for conjunction in the two places; (الذي) is a relative noun in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هذا) ; (به) is attached to (تكذّبون) .
Clause: «إنّهم ... لمحجوبون» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «إنّهم لصالوا الجحيم ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.
And the clause: «يقال ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.
And the clause: «هذا الذي ... » is in the position of a nominative, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) [Note: it is in origin a clause of quoted speech (maqūl al-qawl).] .
And the clause: «كنتم به تكذّبون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي) .
And the clause: «تكذّبون» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كنتم.

* Morphology:
(محجوبون): plural of محجوب, a passive participle of the triliteral حجب, on the pattern مفعول.

* Rhetoric:
Simile of representation (al-tamthīl): in His saying, the Exalted, «كَلَّا إِنَّهُمْ عَنْ رَبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَمَحْجُوبُونَ» .
Whoever denies that He, the Exalted, can be seen, such as the Muʿtazila, says: the speech is a representation of contempt for them and humiliation of them, because admission to kings is granted only to the esteemed notables in their eyes, and only the lowly and despised are barred from them.

safi-cedvel:18-21.t:
* I'rab:
(كلّها إنّ ... كتاب مرقوم) is like the verse كلّا إنّ ... كتاب مرقوم [Note: in verse (7) of this sūra and those that follow.] ... in its words and clauses.
And the clause: «يشهده المقرّبون ... » is in the position of a nominative, a second khabar (predicate) of the implied mubtadaʾ (subject) (هو) .

* Morphology:
(علّيّون): plural of علّيّ, a derived adjective, on the pattern فعّيل (with kasra on the fāʾ and a doubled ʿayn); or it is a singular in the form of a plural, having no singular from its own wording, its meaning being the book that gathers the good deeds.

* Benefits:
- كلّا:
It is a particle whose meaning is rebuke and deterrence. The grammarians permitted pausing on it and beginning with what follows it. A group said: whenever you hear (كلّا) in a sūra, judge that it is Meccan, because it carries the meaning of threat and warning, and most of that was revealed in Mecca, because most of the insolence was there. This statement is open to question, because كلا sometimes does not carry the meaning of deterrence, as in His saying, the Exalted (ألا يظن أولئك أنهم مبعوثون، ليوم عظيم. يوم يقوم الناس لرب العالمين. كلا إن كتاب الفجار لفي سجّين) .
Al-Kisāʾī, Abū Ḥātim and those who agreed with them held that the meaning of rebuke and deterrence does not continue in it, so they added a second meaning to it, on the basis of which it is correct to pause before it and to begin with it. Then they differed in specifying that meaning, in three views:
1- Al-Kisāʾī and his followers said: it is in the sense of حقا ("truly").
2- Abū Ḥātim and his followers said: it is in the sense of the opening (ألا) .
3- Al-Naḍr ibn Shumayl, al-Farrāʾ and those who agreed with them said: it is a particle of response, equivalent to (إي) and (نعم) , and they interpreted His saying, the Exalted, accordingly: (كلا والقمر) , saying that its meaning is: إي والقمر ("yes, by the moon").
Abū Ḥātim's view is better than their two views, because it is more consistent: أنّ takes kasra after the opening (ألا) but does not take kasra after حقا; and because explaining a particle by a particle is preferable to explaining a particle by a noun. Sometimes (كلا) carries both the meaning of deterrence and the meaning of opening, as in His saying, the Exalted: (رب ارجعون لعلي أعمل صالحا فيما تركت كلا إنها كلمة هو قائلها ومن ورائهم برزخ إلى يوم يبعثون) , because if it were in the sense of حقا, the hamza of إن after it would not take kasra; and if it were in the sense of نعم, it would be a promise to return, because it comes after a request, as when one says (أكرم فلانا) and you answer:
(نعم) .

safi-cedvel:22-28.t:
* I'rab:
(اللام) is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (في نعيم) is attached to the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; (على الأرائك) is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of ينظرون; (في وجوههم) is attached to (تعرف) ; (من رحيق) is attached to (يسقون) ; (الواو) is parenthetical; (في ذلك) is attached to the verb (يتنافس) ; (الفاء) connects the apodosis of an omitted conditional; (اللام) is the lām of command; (الواو) is a conjunction; (من تسنيم) is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (مزاج) ; (عينا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being أعني ("I mean") or أمدح ("I praise") or يسقون ("they are given to drink"); (بها) is attached to (يشرب) , by its implying the sense of "to be quenched" or "to take delight".
Clause: «إنّ الأبرار لفي نعيم ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «ينظرون ... » is in the position of a nominative, a second khabar «1» .
And the clause: «تعرف ... » is in the position of a nominative, a third khabar «2» .
And the clause: «يسقون ... » is in the position of a nominative, a fourth khabar «3» .
And the clause: «ختامه مسك ... » is in the position of a genitive, a second naʿt (adjective) of رحيق.
And the clause: «ليتنافس المتنافسون ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an omitted conditional, i.e. if competition in things is to be completed, let the competitors compete in that.. The omitted conditional clause is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.
And the clause: «مزاجه من تسنيم ... » is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause ختامه مسك.
And the clause: «يشرب بها المقرّبون ... » is in the position of an accusative, a naʿt of (عينا) .

* Morphology:
(25) رحيق: a noun for pure wine, on the pattern فعيل.
(مختوم): a passive participle of the triliteral ختم, on the pattern مفعول.
(26) ختامه: either a noun for the thing with which one seals, or a maṣdar (verbal noun) meaning mixing and blending, or meaning "sealing" (with fatḥa on the khāʾ); its pattern is فعال (with kasra on the fāʾ).
(مسك): a noun for a pleasant scent; it is inert (jāmid), on the pattern فعل (with kasra then sukūn).
(المتنافسون): plural of المتنافس, an active participle of the quinqueliteral تنافس, on the pattern متفاعل (with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn).
(27) تسنيم: it is said to be a proper name of a particular spring in Paradise. In origin it is a regular maṣdar of the quadriliteral سنّم, meaning "to raise", or it is used as a maṣdar explained by (عينا) ; its pattern is تفعيل.

safi-cedvel:29-32.t:
* I'rab:
(من الذين) is attached to (يضحكون) ; (بهم) is attached to (مرّوا) ; (إلى أهلهم) is attached to (انقلبوا) ; (فكهين) is an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of انقلبوا; (اللام) is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis..
Clause: «إنّ الذين أجرموا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «أجرموا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «كانوا ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
And the clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «يضحكون ... » is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كانوا..
And the clause: «the condition, its verb and its apodosis ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause يضحكون [Note: or to the clause that is the khabar of انّ: (كانوا ... ) .]
And the clause: «مرّوا ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of a genitive construct).
And the clause: «يتغامزون ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «the second condition, its verb and its apodosis ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause يضحكون [Note: or in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause كانوا.. or conjoined to the first clause of the condition, its verb and its apodosis.] .
And the clause: «انقلبوا ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «انقلبوا (the second) ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «إذا رأوهم قالوا ... » is in the position of an accusative, or a nominative, conjoined to the preceding clause of the condition, its verb and its apodosis.
And the clause: «رأوهم ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «إنّ هؤلاء لضالّون ... » is in the position of an accusative, the quoted speech (maqūl al-qawl).

* Morphology:
(31) فكهين: plural of فكه.. a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) from the triliteral فكه (of the bāb of فرح), on the pattern فعل (with fatḥa then kasra).

safi-cedvel:33-33.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is circumstantial; (ما) is a negative; (عليهم) is attached to (حافظين) [Note: the pronoun in (عليهم) refers to the believers.] ; (حافظين) is an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in (أرسلوا) .
Clause: «ما أرسلوا ... » is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of قالوا.

safi-cedvel:34-36.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) connects the apodosis of an omitted conditional; (اليوم) is an adverb of time attached to the upcoming (يضحكون) ; (من الكفار) is attached to the (يضحكون) after it; (على الأرائك) is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of ينظرون [Note: and see verse (23) of this sūra.] ; (هل) is an interrogative particle; (ما) is a maṣdar (verbal noun) particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of an accusative by removal of the preposition.. and the returning pronoun is omitted.] ..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا ... ) is in the position of an accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: مما كانوا ...
Clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «الذين آمنوا ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an omitted conditional, i.e.: if those who committed crimes laughed at those who believed in the world, then those who believed laugh today at the unbelievers.
And the clause: «يضحكون ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الذين) .
And the clause: «ينظرون ... » is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from the fāʿil of يضحكون.
And the clause: «ثوّب الكفّار ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: or it is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of looking suspended by the interrogative, with the preposition implied.. and it is said that it is in the position of an accusative as quoted speech of an implied saying, i.e.: the believers say to one another: have the unbelievers been repaid ...] .
